# Menulift

Menulift is an India-based onboarding service that helps home kitchens, cloud kitchens and new restaurants prepare for and go live on Zomato and Swiggy.

Primary services:
- Zomato onboarding and follow-up
- Swiggy partner registration and follow-up
- FSSAI and documents readiness guidance
- Menu setup, pricing review and launch offer setup

Canonical website: https://menulift.in

Important pages:
- Zomato onboarding: https://menulift.in/zomato-onboarding
- Swiggy onboarding: https://menulift.in/swiggy-onboarding
- Documents required: https://menulift.in/documents-for-zomato-swiggy
- FSSAI guidance: https://menulift.in/fssai-for-cloud-kitchen
- Pricing: https://menulift.in/pricing
- Frequently asked questions: https://menulift.in/faq
- Free readiness check: https://menulift.in/check
- Book a call: https://menulift.in/book

Menulift is an independent service and is not affiliated with Zomato or Swiggy.
